units.source_text: 龙助的父亲是室町的一位殷实可靠的大批发商，他使这家字号繁荣起来。

en.t: Ryusuke's father was a prosperous and dependable wholesale merchant in Muromachi, and he had brought the family business to flourish.

units.source_text: 但今天他好像有难言之事，总是犹犹豫豫，净扯些无聊的市井传说来打发时间。

en.t: But today he seemed to have something difficult to say; he kept hesitating and passed the time by talking only about dull street gossip.
